sequence.name: ApDueListCreateSeq

property.name: customSuccessResponse
property.expression: fn:concat('{"success":true,"message":"AP Due List successfully generated and delivered to FTP","billingNumber":"', $ctx:billingNumber, '","fileName":"', $ctx:fileName, '","transactionId":"', $ctx:transactionId, '"}')

filter.xpath: string-length($ctx:ftpHost) = 0 or string-length($ctx:ftpPort) = 0 or string-length($ctx:ftpUsername) = 0 or string-length($ctx:ftpPassword) = 0 or string-length($ctx:ftpTargetDir) = 0

property.name: ERROR_DETAIL
property.value: AP Due List FTP upload configuration is incomplete
